cases.scene: At an optional gathering Mira eagerly approaches strangers because she enjoys attention. She refuses a safe untraceable opportunity to exploit Leon for unfair gain. Concerning an uncertain danger, she declines offered protection, saying she feels no worry and needs no reassurance. Later she deliberately retaliates for an insult after the threat has passed. Alone, she voluntarily abandons an unfinished obligation, saying she cannot be bothered. In her free time she pursues an unfamiliar puzzle because she wants to understand it. While freely dividing jointly controlled rewards, she takes a disproportionate share because she prioritizes her own allocation. She explicitly favors established tradition and stability over novelty because she values continuity.
